editorial.blurb: A vibrant new all-you-can-eat sushi spot where every bite captures the natural sweetness of pristinely fresh fish, from thick-cut sashimi to generously filled hand rolls.
editorial.insiderTip: Come as a walk-in or be prepared for a short wait during peak times; the AYCE format lets you explore numerous roll options, so consider bringing friends to share and maximize variety.
